nom: First Aid Beauty Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid +Ceramides

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin mostly describe the gel-cream as lightweight and non-greasy, though a few with more oily skin found it too heavy, oily, or slightly sticky, especially when over-applied.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, cracked, or flaky skin frequently credit it with resolving dryness within days, though one reviewer who tried it specifically for dry skin found it not hydrating enough on its own, especially in winter.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including several with an oily T-zone and drier cheeks, describe it as balancing both areas without over-hydrating the oily zone or leaving the dry zone tight.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and reactive skin, including rosacea- and eczema-prone reviewers, is repeatedly described as tolerating the product with no irritation or breakouts, apart from one reviewer whose rosacea flared badly and whose face turned red and itchy.
segments.normal: A few reviewers, including some testing it on a partner's or husband's skin, report it working well on normal skin, absorbing quickly without greasiness.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including those with cracked or flaky dry skin, report the moisturizer resolving dryness within days of use, but at least one reviewer with dry skin found it insufficiently hydrating on its own and preferred a richer cream in colder months.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea or general redness report it calming their skin, though one reviewer's rosacea flared badly with visible redness and itching after use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers dealing with a compromised moisture barrier, including cystic acne and seborrheic dermatitis, report it helping their skin recover and tolerate other products better.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone and oily reviewers, including a teenager and someone switching from a reformulated cleanser that broke them out, consistently report no new breakouts and some improvement in existing acne.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe it as controlling oil and leaving a matte-ish, non-greasy finish even on oily or combination T-zones, though a handful found it left their skin feeling oily or sticky, particularly when over-applied.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup and sunscreen without pilling
Can feel greasy or tacky when over-applied
Small jar empties quickly with regular use
Can transfer grease onto hair near the hairline

extraits.titre: How is this replacing the coconut water cream?!
extraits.texte: Unfortunately, my favorite moisturizer that I've been using for years has been discontinued (the Coconut Water Cream Moisturizer), so I decided to try FAB's new moisturizer and it's awful (for me). I have very oily skin in the spring and summer, and normal skin with dry patches at times in the fall and winter. I also suffer from acne. When I read that this is supposed to be lightweight, breathable, and non-oily, I thought it would be a great replacement but I was incredibly wrong. It's heavy and extremely oily. I only used a dime-size amount for my entire face and neck but even that felt like way too much! It never fully absorbed into my skin and I cannot stand the feeling of a greasy product sitting on my face. This will most likely be perfect for those with super dry skin but this isn't the one for the oily fam! FAB, PLEASE BRING BACK THE COCONUT WATER CREAM!!! PLEASE!!! IT'S THE ONLY MOISTURIZER THAT HAS WORKED FOR ME FOR 6 YEARS!!! :(

I had such high hopes from the reviews, only to be let down. Here's how I got here, I love first aid beauty ultra repair cream, it is fantastic for hydrating snd calming my skin but it also leaves my skin a little too oily for my liking. So I tried the ultra repair cream with oil control as a solution but it wasn't helping hydrate my skin at all. After all the fabulous reviews, I thought I had finally found the answer, I was wrong. My rosacea is flaring horribly. My entire face looks red and vieny, and it's also slightly itchy. I havent changed anything else so it has to be this moisturizer. I just dont get how it works so well for everyone else but not me. Sad.

I typically NEVER write reviews about products but this mostuzier deserves so much recognition. Ive dealt with having a hard time finding good mosturizers for a decade now and spent countless $$ to find a good one, but when i stumbled upon this product wholy crap never going back to anything else but THIS. I am a person who had acne prone sensitive dry skin and this has done miracles. Ive looked for a mosturizer that my skin doesnt automatically suck up immediately and leave me looking "dry" this does the opposite and leaves that dewy look. Its so so so worth it for the price and honestly as someone who has also suffered with cystic acne from a young age i have seen a lot of improvement in my acne as well! It recovers your skin barrier FAST if anyone is suffering from that.

The Hydrating Dewy Gel Cream Moisturizer is a solid choice for those with normal to oily skin if you want a lightweight moisturizer that helps support and protect your skin's moisture barrier. I tried this on my dry skin (which is not listed as a skin type for this moisturizer) and it isn't hydrating enough, unfortunately. I also tried this on my husband's normal skin and it absorbed quickly without looking or feeling greasy/oily, creating a hydrated, dewy look. I will save this for spring when my skin bounces back, because I love the lightweight feel, the gentleness, and the hydrating properties. Gifted by FAB.

I've got combo skin, oily in the T-zone and dry everywhere else, so finding the right moisturizer is always a struggle. This has been a lifesaver! It's hydrating enough for my dry patches, but it doesn't make my oily areas any worse. It gives my skin this nice, dewy glow, which I love. It's also affordable, especially compared to some of the other high-end moisturizers I've tried. Gifted by First Aid Beauty.

Listen, I dont write reviews often but when I do— that's how you know it's real good. For reference: have extremely sensitive, dry, acne prone skin. And this product does not break me out, cause any irritation, and it actually gets the job done. Most gel moisturizers evaporate off my face within minutes but not this one!!
